name: p67_battery_image_draw

ownership.argument: Borrowed current native draw layer; initialized module-owned 112-byte descriptor and four-int32 destination area. Descriptor source+28 references completed, cache-cleaned, module-owned ARGB8888 battery draw buffer.
ownership.return_value: No ownership transfer. Source pixels and draw-buffer descriptor remain immutable and alive until BOTH native LVGL task queues are idle and GPU completion succeeds.

side_effects: Native image draw-task submission to the current layer

provenance.source: Exact .043 read-only native ABI audit and existing native background image task ABI; source at descriptor+28.

notes: Submit at current object coordinates expanded by current extra draw size; inherit the live layer clip, transform and opacity. Do not replace a display draw-buffer pointer or edit framebuffer pixels. Raw GPU finish alone is not a native task-queue retirement proof. Hardware NOT_PROBED; exact address only.
